text:
maria_ops: Heads up — vendor luis says 12x A100 shipments from PO#4821 flagged DOA/thermal during QC in FRA. This will impact Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 next week. Any quick options? :grimacing:

ryan_sourcing: Ugh. ETA on replacements from vendor?

luis_vendor: We have 6 units ready to ship air express, 6 need depot repair. Air would be 48h EU door, expedite fee applies. Can share AWB and photos. We can do partial RMA now.

maria_ops: Can you confirm serial ranges that are DOA? We need to reconcile with inventory to avoid double-allocs.

luis_vendor: Serial list (sample): S/N 21A4-0001, 21A4-0002, 21A4-0005, 21A4-0009, 21A4-0011, 21A4-0012 — sending full CSV to @alice_logistics. Also customs HS code for air is 8471.70, no duties expected. Photos: https://files.vendor.example/PO4821_photos.zip

alice_logistics: Received CSV. Depot in FRA has 4 staging bays free this week. If we air 6 units, can we slot same-day handoff to forwarder?

luis_vendor: Yes. Forwarder ETA same-day if we send pickup by 16:00 CET. AWB will be 1Z999AA0000000001. Cost for air per unit: €3250 expedite + courier.

andy_infra: If 6 air arrive, how many GPUs get back into pool after imaging/validation? Need to plan capacity: Dedicated eu-west-1 target throughput will drop ~20% if only 6/12 arrive.

maria_ops: We can't drop below 80% for the enterprise P1 customer on Dedicated. Options: (a) accept 6 air + rotate some lower-TFLOPS models behind a routing policy, (b) pay air for all 12, (c) borrow from apac spare pool.

ryan_sourcing: APAC borrow is possible but cross-border customs will add 4-6 days. Cost-wise air for 12 is ~€39k; borrowing adds network transit risk and rebalancing ops.

alice_logistics: Depot repair timeline for the 6 units is 7-10 business days. If we send them to depot repair in NL, turnaround might be faster (5-7 days) but transit + customs sync.

maria_ops: Vendor — can you provide insure/replace vs repair cost delta, and a written commitment on serial reconciliation? Need invoice amendment for expedite fees.

luis_vendor: We can do swap+replace for all 12 for €38,500 (flat) with AWB and priority handling. Swap includes cross-ship and warranty transfer. Otherwise air-6 + repair-6 option stands.

andy_infra: Note: swapping all 12 introduces invoice credit complexity. Finance will need a PO amendment. Also update routing rules to fallback to gtx-variants for non-critical routes to preserve latency SLOs.

maria_ops: @ryan_sourcing please confirm if finance can approve €38.5k urgent PO amendment today. If not, we'll do air-6 and adjust routing.

ryan_sourcing: Pinged finance. They asked for written vendor guarantee and photo evidence of DOA per unit. Also need forwarder contract and AWB before sign-off.

luis_vendor: I'll push photos and a short warranty guarantee PDF in 30m. Can you also confirm depot contact: FRA Dock 3 — ops@fra-depot.example?

alice_logistics: Confirmed FRA Dock 3 contact. If vendor sends pre-alert to ops@fra-depot.example with AWB and manifest, we can accept same-day and image overnight.

maria_ops: Ok plan: Luis to send guarantee + photos + AWB. If finance approves PO amendment by EOD, vendor does swap for all 12. Else air-6 + repair-6 with depot pre-alert and APAC borrow as fallback. I'll open a change ticket for routing adjustments.

vendor_bot: RMA ticket #RMA-2026-888 created, status: awaiting vendor docs.

ryan_sourcing: Thanks — watching. :eyes:

maria_ops: Closing loop — will post updates when finance responds.
